name: Unsafe Reflection
attack_scenario: user input names the attribute/module/class to resolve, so an attacker selects a method or module the developer never exposed, escalating to arbitrary code paths or command execution
negative_test_hint: submit action = a dangerous name (e.g. 'system' / 'os') and assert only the allowlisted handlers are reachable

exemplar.explanation: map user input through a fixed allowlist to a known target; never resolve it through reflection directly
